messages:
mike_support: Customer reported repeated parsing failures when using structured_output/json mode.

mike_support: They say the model returns a string that contains an embedded null character and mixed escape forms, e.g. "Hello\u0000World" and sometimes a literal \x00 present in stream. Parser throws "Invalid control character" during streaming.

alex_sre: Can you paste the request_id + raw chunks? also which model + streaming on/off?

mike_support: req=rc_8a7f2c, model=redwood-small-v1, streaming=true, structured_mode=json

mike_support: Raw chunk sample:
```
{"id":1,"text":"Start of text\u0000\nmore text with backslash\\u0000 sequence\n"}
```

mike_support: Note: sometimes we see actual NUL bytes in the bytes stream (not the unicode escape). Example bytes shown in hex:
```
48 65 6c 6c 6f 00 57 6f 72 6c 64 5c 75 30 30 30 0a
```

priya_eng: That hex shows a literal 0x00 between Hello and World, plus a literal backslash-u sequence later. Streaming parser treats 0x00 as invalid control char and drops connection.

casey_support: Customer says reproduction occurs only when they stream through our websocket relay (we patch headers). Non-streamed REST returns valid JSON.

alex_sre: Possible causes: kernel->runtime encoding mismatch on batch boundaries, or our streaming chunker splitting multi-byte UTF-8 sequences incorrectly, turning UTF-8 NUL-encoded sequences into literal NUL. Also check any normalize/strip steps in websocket relay.

priya_eng: Suggest steps to repro: 1) cURL to websocket relay with streaming enabled 2) set sample_rate=deterministic 3) capture raw tcp bytes with tcpdump 4) run local parser expecting JSON mode

mike_support: I've attached minimal repro (pasted below). Client uses websocket, sends prompt -> we forward to runtime. When chunk boundary splits the sequence "\u0000" across frames we get a literal 0x00 inserted.

mike_support: Repro snippet (pseudo):
```
client -> relay: open WS
relay -> runtime: start stream
runtime chunk1: "...\u00"
runtime chunk2: "00World..."  <-- boundary
relay forwards chunks, but due to memcpy/encoding we see 0x00 inserted
```

priya_eng: Can you collect a trace with CORRELATION_ID header on next failing run? add header X-Trace: rc_8a7f2c so we can cross-ref.

mike_support: will do. For short term, customer accepted workaround: disable streaming and use REST, but wants streaming use-case fixed.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-2345 assigned to @priya_eng and @alex_sre

alex_sre: I'll instrument the websocket layer and add a test for chunk boundary splitting of escape sequences. If it's a memcpy bug we can hotfix in relay binary.

casey_support: Please keep me posted, I'll coordinate comms with account team.

mike_support: thanks all, i'll update with tcpdump + correlation id once available. :thumbsup:
